1 (Currently amended): An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use, wherein the control means is further configured to adjust the operation of the first and second valves based on real-time feedback from at least one sensor.

2 (Currently amended): The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising plural first valves and/or plural second valves, wherein the plural valves are configured to operate in conjunction with the control means.

3 (Currently amended): The air braking unit of claim 2, wherein the plural valves may comprise one or more larger valves arranged to allow large volumes of air to pass therethrough and one or more smaller valves arranged to allow passage of smaller volumes of air therethrough, with the control means selectively activating the larger and smaller valves based on operational requirements.

4 (Currently amended): The air braking unit of claim 3, wherein the one or more smaller valves are arranged to operate at high speed, enhancing the responsiveness of the braking system.

5 (Currently amended): The air braking unit of claim 1, wherein one or more of the valves are driven by binary actuators, allowing for precise control of the air flow.

6 (Currently amended): An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive control signals from a wheel speed sensor and an air pressure sensor for determining the pressure in the brake chamber, and is further arranged to process data from these sensors to optimize braking performance.

7 (Currently amended): An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds, and control braking force based thereon, thereby improving the efficiency of the braking system.

8 (Currently amended): An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors, and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed, thereby enhancing vehicle stability during braking.

9 (Currently amended): An air braking system comprising one or more units according to any preceding claim; a pump for generating compressed air; and a central compressed air storage tank, wherein the system is configured to optimize braking performance based on real-time feedback from the sensors.
